assertions.subject: Lewy Body Dementia
assertions.quote: Lewy Body Dementia (LBD) encompasses two clinical entities: dementia with Lewy bodies and Parkinson disease dementia.

assertions.subject: Lewy Body Dementia
assertions.quote: Lewy Body Dementia (LBD) encompasses two clinical entities: dementia with Lewy bodies and Parkinson disease dementia. It is a progressive degenerative brain disorder characterized by dementia, psychosis, and features of parkinsonism.

assertions.subject: Lewy Body Dementia
assertions.quote: Diagnosis of LBD requires thorough clinical examination, as many of its features overlap with other dementia disorders.

assertions.subject: Lewy Body Dementia
assertions.quote: The interesting phenomenon of various biochemical markers that accumulate in DLB and PD dementia including alpha-synuclein, ubiquitin, tau, and amyloid provides evidence of the multi-factorial and complex processes that become dysfunctional in chronic and progressive neurodegenerative disease such as DLB and PD dementia.
